name: Aria
source:
A maid that takes care of Toono Haruka. She has mysterious origins.

[spoiler]In the real world, she works as a nurse where Ayumu is hospitalized in.

Her mother died due to childbirth complications from her and blames herself for it.

In the dream world, she was the future daughter of Haruka and Nagisa.[/spoiler]
